notes.title: Improved Scene Stability on GPUs Without Direct3D 11 Support
notes.content: Resolved an issue where certain GPU environments unable to use Direct3D 11 caused specific scenes to malfunction, improving their functionality.

notes.title: Improved Internal Wait Processing
notes.content:
Improved the internal wait-related processing.
As a result, the issue preventing startup under certain limited conditions has been resolved.
Thank you BSoD san, rua san.

notes.title: Simplified Chinese version
notes.content: The Simplified Chinese version of "Pudding" was officially released.
- Fixed a phenomenon that prevented entering the stage from the title under special conditions.
